state.error_body: We could not load this event. Check your connection and try again.
state.denied_body: Only the event's hosts can message attendees.

quick.caption: A short message to the people at your event. In-app and push only.
quick.markdown_hint: You can use **bold**, *italic*, links and lists.
quick.retry_note: Sending again reuses the same draft, applying any edits you made. It cannot go out twice.
quick.discard_already_sending: That message already started sending, so it cannot be discarded.
quick.edits_lost: The earlier version of this message already went out. The edits you just made were not sent.
quick.channels_note: Sent in the app and as a push notification. Email and scheduling live in the host dashboard.
quick.channels_email_note: Sent by email to everyone registered. In-app and push messages live in the host dashboard.

toast.sent: Your message is on its way.

error.rate_limited: You have sent a lot of messages recently. Please wait before sending another.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to message this event.
error.conflict: This event is closed to messaging.
error.validation: Please check the subject, the message and any links.
error.held: This message was held for review.
error.generic: Your message could not be sent. Please try again.

confirm.title: Send this message?
confirm.subject: Subject: {{subject}}
confirm.body: This goes to {{audience}} now, in the app and as a push notification. It cannot be unsent.

list.title: Messages
list.hint: civfix relays your message. You never see an attendee's address, and they can unsubscribe from any of them.
list.empty_body: Send an update, a reminder or a thank-you to the people who signed up.

composer.subject: Subject
composer.body_hint: Bold, italics, links and lists only. Links must be https.
composer.slots_members_only: Guests do not hold shifts, so a shift audience reaches members only.
composer.test_cap: You have used this hour's test sends.
composer.test_rate_limited: You have reached the test-send limit for this hour.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.privacy_note: Deliveries record only whether a message went out. civfix stores no address and no copy of the body here, and anyone who unsubscribed never appears in this list.
deliveries.empty_body: Deliveries appear once the message starts sending.

send_confirm.title: Send this message?
send_confirm.body: It goes to {{count}} people and cannot be recalled.
send_confirm.banner: Every recipient can unsubscribe from your messages after this one.
send_confirm.agreement: I have read the message and want to send it now.

cancel_confirm.title: Cancel this message?
cancel_confirm.banner: Remaining deliveries are stopped and recorded as suppressed.
